breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The ground truth resolved this by removing the periodic condition. The agent's generated specification correctly omits the periodic condition and only includes the Dirichlet boundary conditions 'u(0,t) = 0 and u(1,t) = 0', thus resolving the inconsistency.
